C1065.title: Police Cruiser Vandalized in Henan: Six Arrested After Incident
C1065.summary: Around 11 p.m. on January 2, 2023, at Hongdao Yuan Plaza on Ziqì Avenue in Luyi County, Henan, a small group deliberately damaged a parked police cruiser, drawing a crowd and causing public disorder with serious negative impact.
